check: Authenticate the request and confirm identity, engagement, current start time and time zone
owner_role: Proposed People owner or authorized sponsor
expected_evidence: Verified request reference; identity check; current revision and authorized preparation/activation conditions
notes: Keep personnel details in the protected case; a display name or forwarded request alone is insufficient.

check: Resolve existing identity, rehire, guest, naming and authoritative-directory conflicts
approval_required: Preparation authority from the authenticated request
expected_evidence: Directory reconciliation and conflict decision; intended identity and environment
notes: Do not merge or duplicate identities based only on matching names.

check: Approve the work-based service and entitlement matrix, including excluded and privileged scope
approval_required: System/data owner approval; separate security approval where required
expected_evidence: Approved service-by-service scope, duration and entitlement decisions
notes: Requesting and approving sensitive access must be separate; include direct and automatic grants.

check: Set temporary-access expiry, sponsor and removal owner or record why this is not applicable
approval_required: Authorized engagement duration and expiry plan
expected_evidence: Approved end time and time zone; removal task and owner or applicability rationale
notes: Silence is not renewal; an approved extension updates scope and end time explicitly.

check: Verify required license/features, seat availability and purchase authority
owner_role: Proposed Purchasing owner and service operator
approval_required: Spending approval if needed; approved access scope
expected_evidence: Entitlement and feature check; purchase decision where needed
notes: An available seat does not establish that required security or records controls are licensed.

check: Create or reconcile identity and verify the approved activation boundary
expected_evidence: Observed authoritative identity state and downstream activation limits
notes: Staging may trigger invitations or grants; use the actual platform runbook and do not assume a staging mode.

check: Apply approved service grants and observe each target provisioning result
approval_required: Approved service-specific scope and required licenses
expected_evidence: Target account, group and entitlement observations; failed or pending job records
proposed_target: Before the service is represented as ready
notes: Expand by service; a source assignment or accepted job alone does not demonstrate usable access.

check: Prepare the assigned device and verify the adopted build controls
approval_required: Approved device/ownership model and current build standard
expected_evidence: Device identity, enrollment and applicable control results; protected recovery capability
notes: No recovery secrets in the case; inventory registration alone is not proof of security controls.

check: Verify recipient and record actual asset custody or an approved alternative
expected_evidence: Asset assignment and recipient receipt; approved alternative if applicable
notes: A shipping label is not receipt; do not infer permission for unmanaged personal-device use.

check: Deliver approved bootstrap access through the protected recipient-verification process
approval_required: Approved activation condition and secure bootstrap method
expected_evidence: Recipient-check reference; issuance/expiry metadata without the secret; delivery outcome
notes: Do not request the user password, factor seed, recovery codes or authentication approval; re-verify expired bootstrap requests.

check: Have the user establish permitted authentication and confirm the recovery/support route
approval_required: Adopted authentication policy and approved setup method
expected_evidence: Observed enrollment and effective policy checks; safe recovery/support explanation
notes: Enrollment, enforcement and session behavior are distinct; do not weaken policy to work around setup failure.

check: Verify approved data locations and role-specific records or capture controls where required
owner_role: Proposed Records owner and service operator
approval_required: Applicable records direction and authorized test scope
expected_evidence: Control applicability decision; configuration and harmless test result where required
notes: Record a reason for not-applicable; do not assume all people or channels need identical capture controls.

check: Observe representative authorized work and a permitted negative access-boundary check
approval_required: Approved activation and safe test scope
expected_evidence: Task-level expected and actual results, sampled boundary, reviewed entitlement population
notes: Use synthetic content; failure keeps the affected scope pending. Device-related checks may be not applicable only with an approved reason.

check: Explain approved handling and reporting; record policy acknowledgment and comprehension check
owner_role: Proposed IT coordinator and receiving manager
approval_required: Current approved policy and orientation scope
expected_evidence: Policy-version acknowledgment; user explanation of reporting and support steps
notes: An acknowledgment is evidence of receipt, not proof of understanding; include AI use and lost-device reporting as applicable.

check: Review actual results and obtain a scoped readiness decision or owned temporary exceptions
approval_required: Manager scope decision and relevant risk authority for exceptions
expected_evidence: Reviewer findings; usable and blocked scope; linked exception with expiry and review triggers
proposed_target: Before declaring the stated scope ready
verifier_role: Proposed Technical reviewer and receiving manager
notes: Do not claim fully verified readiness with missing evidence; execution and review remain separate records.

check: Confirm early-use outcome and maintain delay, cancellation and expiry follow-up ownership
approval_required: Authenticated change to start/engagement when relevant
expected_evidence: Actual follow-up result; current activation/expiry tasks; linked corrective action or cancellation record
proposed_target: At the agreed checkpoint and on material change
notes: This row may run earlier on a cancellation; stop pending activation, assess existing access/assets, and use offboarding where needed.
